VII. Project experience: The bidder shall provide details and documentary proof of relevant project experience during the last three financial years, namely FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26. Supporting work orders/contracts and satisfactory completion/performance certificates shall be su bmitted. The experience requirement, if any, shall be assessed strictly in accordance with the eligi bility criteria specified in the bid.
